response.rationale: R9 uniquely integrates the anterior mediastinal mass, hepatomegaly, and markedly elevated LDH; the pericardial effusion, muffled heart sounds, and electrical alternans are downstream complications of the mass. R5 captures only the pericardial process, R2 adds nonspecific fever without TB-specific evidence, and C1 is a correlated append-only restatement of R9 with fewer raw spans.

rejected.why: Fever and pericardial effusion are nonspecific; no TB exposure, pulmonary focus, or pericardial fluid evidence; ignores the anterior mediastinal mass and hepatomegaly.
Derivative append-only completion of R9; correlated restatement with fewer raw spans (lacks LDH) and no independent evidence beyond R9.
